title: PRISM: Calibrating Black-Box Judges with Counterfactual Probes
abstract: arXiv:2610.18389v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as judges to reduce reliance on costly human evaluation, yet their scores can systematically disagree with human judgments. We ask whether responses to an explicitly imposed evaluative bias can help correct a judge's implicit scoring biases. We introduce PRISM (Probe-based Residual Inference of Scoring Misalignment), which holds the evaluated content fixed and measures score changes when attributes are emphasized or de-emphasized. A local sensitivity model motivates representing these responses as a surrogate Jacobian. Ridge regression on human labels learns a correction to the baseline score. The resulting scoring protocol is rubric-free: it uses overall scores without requesting criterion-level ratings. In the main Jev and Sol comparisons on SummEval summarization and HANNA story evaluation, PRISM and its learned-baseline variant significantly improve agreement with human rankings over unca

translated_title: PRISM：利用反事实探针校准黑盒评判模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正越来越多地被用作评判模型，以减少对昂贵人工评估的依赖，但其评分可能系统性地与人类判断不一致。我们探究的问题是：对一个显式施加的评估偏差的响应，能否帮助纠正评判模型隐式的评分偏差。我们提出了PRISM（基于探针的评分错位残差推断），该方法保持被评估内容不变，测量当某些属性被强调或弱化时评分的变化。一个局部敏感性模型支持将这些响应表示为代理雅可比矩阵，再通过在人类标签上进行岭回归，学习对基线评分的修正。由此得到的评分协议无需评分细则：它仅使用整体评分，而不要求按标准逐项评分。在SummEval摘要评估和HANNA故事评估的Jev与Sol主要对比实验中，PRISM及其学习基线变体相比未校准基线，显著提升与人类排名的一致性。
tldr: PRISM通过反事实探针测量黑盒大模型评判者对属性强调或弱化时的评分响应，用代理雅可比矩阵与岭回归学习对基线评分的修正，从而在无需评分细则的情况下显著提升其评分与人类排名的一致性。
en_tdlr: PRISM uses counterfactual probes to measure how black-box LLM judges' scores shift when attributes are emphasized or de-emphasized, and learns a correction via a surrogate Jacobian and ridge regression, significantly improving alignment with human rankings without requiring rubrics.
